questions.question: The LCM of 51, 18, 432 and 144 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the given numbers: 51, 18, 432, and 144.

Since 18 and 144 perfectly divide 432, they can be ignored for calculating the LCM.

We only need to find the LCM of 51 and 432.

As 51 = 3 × 17 and 432 is already a multiple of 3, we just multiply 432 by the remaining unique prime factor 17.

LCM = 432 × 17 = 7344.

**∴ The correct answer is 7344.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 51, 18, 432, and 144.

**Method Used:**

Prime factorization method to find the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 51 = 3 × 17

⇒ Prime factorization of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 432 = 2⁴ × 3³

⇒ Prime factorization of 144 = 2⁴ × 3²

⇒ To find the LCM, we take the highest power of each prime factor present.

⇒ Highest power of 2 = 2⁴

⇒ Highest power of 3 = 3³

⇒ Highest power of 17 = 17¹

⇒ LCM = 2⁴ × 3³ × 17

⇒ LCM = 16 × 27 × 17

⇒ LCM = 432 × 17 = 7344

**∴ The correct answer is 7344.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lowest Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest number that is a multiple of all given numbers. It is found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors involved.

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The largest number that perfectly divides all given numbers without leaving a remainder. It is found by multiplying the lowest powers of common prime factors.

Product Rule for Two Numbers

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their LCM and HCF: A × B = LCM(A, B) × HCF(A, B).

Coprime Numbers

Two numbers are coprime if their HCF is 1. The LCM of two coprime numbers is always equal to their direct product.
</p

questions.question: The average age of 40 students in a class is 12 years. The average age of group of 5 of students is 10 years and that of another group of 5 of them is 14 years. The average age of the remaining students is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial average of 40 students = 12 years.

Deviation for first 5 students = 5 × (10 − 12) = −10 years.

Deviation for next 5 students = 5 × (14 − 12) = +10 years.

Net deviation of these 10 students = −10 + 10 = 0.

Since the net deviation of removed students is 0, the average of remaining students remains unchanged.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students = 40

Average age of all 40 students = 12 years

Average age of first group of 5 students = 10 years

Average age of second group of 5 students = 14 years

 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 5
 5
 30 Students
 
 10 yrs
 14 yrs
 ? yrs

 

 Total 40 Students (Avg = 12 years)

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 40 students = 40 × 12 = 480 years

⇒ Total age of first 5 students = 5 × 10 = 50 years

⇒ Total age of next 5 students = 5 × 14 = 70 years

⇒ Total age of these 10 students = 50 + 70 = 120 years

⇒ Number of remaining students = 40 − 10 = 30 students

⇒ Total age of remaining 30 students = 480 − 120 = 360 years

⇒ Average age of remaining students = 360 ÷ 30 = 12 years

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all individual values from their average is always zero. If a removed subgroup has a net deviation of exactly zero, the remaining subgroup will perfectly retain the original average.

Weighted Average Formula

Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...), where n is the number of elements and A is the average of each respective group.
</p

questions.question: The fourth proportional to 4, a and 16a is 81. Find the value of a².

For four numbers in proportion, the product of extremes equals the product of means.

⇒ 4 × 81 = a × 16a

⇒ 324 = 16a²

⇒ a² = 324 ÷ 16 = 20.25

**∴ The correct answer is 20.25.**

**Given:**

First term = 4

Second term = a

Third term = 16a

Fourth proportional = 81

**Formula Used:**

If four values a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d

Product of Means = Product of Extremes

questions.question: Two trains, 200 m and 250 m long, are moving in the same direction at speeds of 80 km/hr and 60 km/hr, respectively. How long (in seconds) will it take for the faster train to completely pass the slower one?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (same direction) = (80 − 60) × 5/18 = 20 × 5/18 = 50/9 m/s

Total distance to cross completely = Length of Faster Train + Length of Slower Train = 200 + 250 = 450 m

Time required = Total distance ÷ Relative speed = 450 ÷ (50/9) = 450 × 9/50 = 81 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 81 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of faster train (L₁) = 200 m

Length of slower train (L₂) = 250 m

Speed of faster train (S₁) = 80 km/hr

Speed of slower train (S₂) = 60 km/hr

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 Relative Speed = 80 − 60 = 20 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

When two objects move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂

Time taken to cross = (Total length of both trains) ÷ (Relative Speed)

Conversion factor from km/hr to m/s = Multiply by 5/18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂ = 200 + 250 = 450 m

⇒ Relative Speed = 80 − 60 = 20 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 20 × (5/18) = 100/18 = 50/9 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 450 ÷ (50/9)

⇒ Time taken = 450 × 9 ÷ 50

⇒ Time taken = 9 × 9 = 81 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 81 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Stationary Object (Negligible length)

When a train crosses a pole or a standing man, the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train alone. Formula: Time = Lₜᵣₐᵢₙ ÷ Speed.

Crossing a Platform or Bridge

When a train crosses an object with a significant length (like a platform or bridge), the total distance covered is the sum of the train's length and the object's length. Formula: Time = (Lₜᵣₐᵢₙ + Lₚₗₐₜfₒᵣₘ) ÷ Speed.
</p

questions.question: Raj has ₹1218 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Varun and Ashish and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Varun and Ashish got same amount after 13 and 14 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Raj give to Ashish?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If amounts are equal after T₁ and T₂ years, then P₁ / P₂ = (1 + R/100)T² − T¹

Here, Ratio of Varun's share to Ashish's share (V/A) = (1 + 10/100)¹⁴ − ¹³ = 11/10

Total ratio parts = 11 + 10 = 21 parts

21 parts = 1218 ⇒ 1 part = 1218 ÷ 21 = 58

Ashish's share (10 parts) = 10 × 58 = 580

**∴ The correct answer is ₹580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Amount = ₹1218

Rate (R) = 10% compounded annually

Time for Varun = 13 years

Time for Ashish = 14 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

questions.question: Find the area (in cm²) of a triangle whose length of each side is 7 cm, 24 cm and 0.25 m.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all sides to the same unit: 0.25 m = 25 cm.

The sides 7 cm, 24 cm, and 25 cm form a Pythagorean triplet (since 7² + 24² = 25²).

∴ The triangle is a right-angled triangle with base 24 cm and height 7 cm.

Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 24 × 7 = 84 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 84 cm².**

questions.question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 8
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 8

**Formula used:**

Follow BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

**Calculation:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-2) × 8

⇒ (-9) - [(-60) ÷ (-15)] + [(-2) × 8]

⇒ (-9) - [60 ÷ 15] + (-16)

⇒ (-9) - 4 + (-16)

⇒ -9 - 4 - 16

⇒ -29

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Chetan invests a sum of ₹5400 and Vipul invests a sum of ₹10200 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 3 years, Vipul gets ₹720 more interest than Chetan, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in Principal = 10200 − 5400 = ₹4800

Difference in Interest for 3 years = ₹720

Difference in Interest for 1 year = 720 ÷ 3 = ₹240

Rate % = (1-year interest ÷ Principal difference) × 100

Rate % = (240 ÷ 4800) × 100 = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Chetan's Principal (P₁) = ₹5400

Vipul's Principal (P₂) = ₹10200

Time (T) = 3 years

Difference in Simple Interest = ₹720

 
 Chetan
 P = ₹5400
 Time = 3 yrs

 
 Vipul
 P = ₹10200
 Time = 3 yrs

 

 
 
 Difference in Principal = ₹4800
 Difference in Interest (3 yrs) = ₹720

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

Let the rate of simple interest be R%.

⇒ Vipul's Interest = (10200 × R × 3) ÷ 100 = 306R

⇒ Chetan's Interest = (5400 × R × 3) ÷ 100 = 162R

Since Vipul gets ₹720 more interest than Chetan:

⇒ 306R − 162R = 720

⇒ 144R = 720

⇒ R = 720 ÷ 144

⇒ R = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated only on the principal amount, whereas Compound Interest is calculated on both the principal and the accumulated interest. SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Proportionality in Simple Interest

If Rate and Time are constant, Simple Interest is directly proportional to the Principal. The difference in simple interest for two different principals will be the interest earned on the difference of the principals.

Amount Formula

The total amount at the end of the time period is given by Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI) = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

questions.question: Given that X is the third proportional of 20 and Y, if Y is the sum of the first three prime numbers, then the value of X is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First three prime numbers are 2, 3, 5 ⇒ Y = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10.

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then c = b² ÷ a.

X = 10² ÷ 20 = 100 ÷ 20 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Y = sum of the first three prime numbers.

X = third proportional of 20 and Y.

**Formula Used:**

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b :: b : c, which gives a ÷ b = b ÷ c.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 20
 
 :
 
 
 10 (Y)
 
 ::
 
 
 10 (Y)
 
 :
 
 
 X
 
 

 ÷ 2
 
 

 ÷ 2
 
 X = 10 ÷ 2 = 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ The first three prime numbers are 2, 3, and 5.

⇒ Y = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10

⇒ X is the third proportional to 20 and 10.

⇒ 20 : 10 :: 10 : X

⇒ 20 ÷ 10 = 10 ÷ X

⇒ 2 = 10 ÷ X

⇒ X = 10 ÷ 2 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion Rule

Four numbers a, b, c, d are in proportion if a : b = c : d, which implies Product of Extremes (a × d) = Product of Means (b × c).

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and c is b, calculated using the formula: b = √(a × c).

Prime Numbers

Numbers strictly greater than 1 that have only two factors: 1 and themselves. The smallest prime number is 2, which is also the only even prime.
</p

questions.question: What time (in seconds) is required for a 398 m long train to cross a 802 m long tunnel, if the train travels at a speed of 45 km/h?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to cover = Length of train + Length of tunnel = 398 + 802 = 1200 m

Speed in m/s = 45 × (5/18) = 12.5 m/s

Time = Total distance ÷ Speed = 1200 ÷ 12.5 = 96 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 96 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

Total Distance = Length of Train + Length of Tunnel

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 398 + 802 = 1200 m

⇒ Speed in m/s = 45 × (5/18) = 25/2 = 12.5 m/s

Conversion of Speed

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by (5/18). To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by (18/5).

Crossing a Stationary Object with Length

When a train crosses a tunnel, bridge, or a standing platform, the total distance covered to clear the object is the sum of the length of the train and the length of the object.

Crossing a Point Object

questions.question: Sachin sold 153 chairs and had a gain equal to the selling price of 85 chairs. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Selling Price (SP) of 1 chair be 1 unit.

Total SP = 153 units, Profit = 85 units.

Cost Price (CP) = SP − Profit = 153 − 85 = 68 units.

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (85 ÷ 68) × 100 = 125%

**∴ The correct answer is 125%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of chairs sold = 153

Gain = Selling price of 85 chairs

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) − Profit

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 
 
 
 
 CP = 68
 Profit = 85
 
 

 Total Selling Price (SP) = 153
 
 Profit % = (85 ÷ 68) × 100 = 125%
 
 Unitary Method Allocation

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Selling Price (SP) of 1 chair be ₹1.

⇒ Total SP for 153 chairs = 153 × 1 = ₹153.

⇒ Profit earned = SP of 85 chairs = 85 × 1 = ₹85.

⇒ CP of 153 chairs = Total SP − Profit.

⇒ CP = 153 − 85 = ₹68.

⇒ Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (85 ÷ 68) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (5 ÷ 4) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 5 × 25 = 125%

**∴ The correct answer is 125%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basic Formulas

Profit = SP − CP and Loss = CP − SP. Profit and Loss percentages are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount. Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer claims to sell goods at cost price but uses a false weight, the actual Profit % = (Error ÷ True Weight − Error) × 100.

questions.question: If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹40 and compound interest is ₹50, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SI for 1st year = 40 ÷ 2 = ₹20.

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = 50 − 40 = ₹10.

This difference is the interest earned on the 1st year's SI.

Rate% = (10 ÷ 20) × 100 = 50%.

Principal = (1st year SI × 100) ÷ Rate = (20 × 100) ÷ 50 = ₹40.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) for 2 years = ₹40

Compound Interest (CI) for 2 years = ₹50

 
• 
 
• 
 

 
 
 Principal P
 
 Year 1 (SI)
 
 ₹ 20
 
 Year 2 (SI)
 
 ₹ 20
 
 
 ₹ 10
 Interest on 1st Yr
 
 Total SI = ₹40 | Total CI = ₹50

**Formula Used:**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = P × (R ÷ 100)²

SI for 2 years = (P × R × 2) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI for 1 year = 40 ÷ 2 = ₹20

⇒ Difference in interests for 2 years = 50 − 40 = ₹10

⇒ The extra interest in CI comes solely from the interest calculated on the 1st year's SI.

⇒ Rate R = (10 ÷ 20) × 100 = 50%

⇒ We know, SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 40 = (P × 50 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 40 = P × 1

⇒ P = ₹40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI (for 2 years)

The difference between CI and SI for exactly 2 years is calculated directly using the formula: Diff = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Difference between CI and SI (for 3 years)

The difference between CI and SI for exactly 3 years is calculated using the formula: Diff = P × (R ÷ 100)² × (3 + R ÷ 100).

Effective Rate for CI (2 years)

If the rate of interest is R% per annum, the effective compound interest rate for 2 years is given by (2R + R² ÷ 100)%.

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 22 days, 24 days and 33 days, respectively. In how many days will the work be finished if, A works on the 1st day, C works on the 2nd day, B works on the 3rd day, A works on the 4th day and so on?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(22, 24, 33) = 264 units & Efficiencies: A = 12, B = 11, C = 8 units/day.

Work done in 1 cycle of 3 days (A + C + B) = 12 + 8 + 11 = 31 units.

Number of complete cycles = 264 ÷ 31 = 8 cycles (24 days), Work done = 31 × 8 = 248 units.

Remaining work = 264 − 248 = 16 units.

On Day 25, A completes 12 units (Remaining = 4). On Day 26, C takes 4 ÷ 8 = 1/2 day.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 1/2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 22 days

Time taken by B = 24 days

Time taken by C = 33 days

Work sequence: A on 1st day, C on 2nd day, B on 3rd day, and so on.

**Method Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done in one cycle of 3 days (A + C + B) = 12 + 8 + 11 = 31 units

⇒ Number of full cycles in 264 units = 264 ÷ 31 = 8 complete cycles

⇒ Time taken for 8 complete cycles = 8 × 3 = 24 days

⇒ Work done in 24 days = 8 × 31 = 248 units

⇒ Remaining work = 264 − 248 = 16 units

⇒ On the 25th day, A works and completes 12 units

⇒ Remaining work after 25 days = 16 − 12 = 4 units

⇒ On the 26th day, C works to complete the remaining 4 units

⇒ Time taken by C = Work to be done ÷ Efficiency of C = 4 ÷ 8 = 1/2 day

⇒ Total time taken = 24 + 1 + 1/2 = 25 1/2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 25 1/2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work Concept

When individuals work on alternate days, first find the total work done in one complete cycle. Divide the total work by the cycle work to get the number of full cycles, and calculate the remaining work for the subsequent days based on their strict working sequence.

Pipes & Cisterns

The concept is completely identical to Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency (filling), while outlet pipes have negative efficiency (emptying) which is useful for alternate minute filling/emptying cycles.

Work & Wages

Wages are strictly distributed in the ratio of the actual total work done by each individual. If they work together for the same number of days, the wages are directly distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

questions.question: The LCM of 36, 30, 114 and 380 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The LCM must be perfectly divisible by all the given numbers, including 36 (divisible by 9) and 30 (divisible by 10).

Divisibility by 10 means the number must end in 0, so we check only 3440 and 3420.

Divisibility by 9 means the sum of the digits must be a multiple of 9.

The sum of the digits for 3440 is 3 + 4 + 4 + 0 = 11 (Not divisible by 9).

The sum of the digits for 3420 is 3 + 4 + 2 + 0 = 9 (Perfectly divisible by 9).

**∴ The correct answer is 3420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 36, 30, 114 and 380.

**Concept Used:**

The Least Common Multiple (LCM) is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors present in the numbers.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 114 = 2 × 3 × 19

⇒ Prime factorization of 380 = 2² × 5 × 19

⇒ The LCM requires the highest power of each prime factor observed (2, 3, 5, and 19).

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 × 19

⇒ LCM = 4 × 9 × 5 × 19

⇒ LCM = 36 × 95 = 3420

**∴ The correct answer is 3420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Fractions

The LCM of two or more fractions is calculated by taking the LCM of the numerators and dividing it by the HCF of the denominators.

HCF of Fractions

The HCF of fractions is calculated by taking the HCF of the numerators and dividing it by the LCM of the denominators.

Product Rule of LCM and HCF

For any two natural numbers, the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are defined as co-prime if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is exactly 1. The LCM of co-prime numbers is always equal to their product.
</p

questions.question: The price (per litre) of petrol increases by 90%. By what percent should its consumption be reduced such that the expenditure on it increases by 33% only?

Let initial price and expenditure be 100 units.

New Price = 100 + 90 = 190 units.

Required % reduction = (57 ÷ 190) × 100 = 30%.

questions.question: Two televisions are sold for ₹7,980 each, gaining 5% from one and losing 5% from the other. Find the gain or loss percentage in the whole transaction.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two items are sold at the same Selling Price, one at a profit of x% and the other at a loss of x%, the overall result is always a net loss.

Net Loss % = (x² ÷ 100)%

Given x = 5%, Net Loss % = (5² ÷ 100)% = 25 ÷ 100% = 0.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 0.25% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price of each television (SP) = ₹7,980

Profit on the first television = 5%

Loss on the second television = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = [100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)] × SP

Cost Price (CP) = [100 ÷ (100 − Loss%)] × SP

Loss % = (Net Loss ÷ Total CP) × 100

 
 

 

CP = ₹7600

• 
+ 5% Profit

SP = ₹7980

CP = ₹8400

• 
− 5% Loss

SP = ₹7980

Total CP = ₹16000 | Total SP = ₹15960 → Net Loss = ₹40

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP of first TV = [100 ÷ (100 + 5)] × 7980

⇒ CP of first TV = (100 ÷ 105) × 7980 = ₹7,600

⇒ CP of second TV = [100 ÷ (100 − 5)] × 7980

⇒ CP of second TV = (100 ÷ 95) × 7980 = ₹8,400

⇒ Total CP of both TVs = 7600 + 8400 = ₹16,000

⇒ Total SP of both TVs = 7980 + 7980 = ₹15,960

⇒ Total Loss = Total CP − Total SP = 16000 − 15960 = ₹40

⇒ Net Loss % = (40 ÷ 16000) × 100 = 0.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 0.25% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

When Selling Price is same (SP₁ = SP₂)

If two items are sold at the same price, gaining x% on one and losing x% on the other, there is always a net loss of (x² ÷ 100)%.

When Cost Price is same (CP₁ = CP₂)

If two items are bought at the same price, and sold with x% profit on one and x% loss on the other, the overall transaction results in No Profit No Loss (0% change).

Dishonest Dealer

When a dealer professes to sell goods at cost price but uses a false weight, the formula applied is Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.

Successive Profit/Discount

For successive changes of x% and y% applied on the same base price, the net effective percentage change is calculated using [x + y + (x × y) ÷ 100]%.
